verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev documents recurring scheduled tasks using cron syntax, and its dashboard can activate and disable schedules, which effectively covers pause/resume. A community user reports the scheduled-task feature works as expected. Queue concurrency limits are adjacent and are not a schedule overlap policy. missing for 10: a documented overlap policy for scheduled runs (skip/buffer/allow), visibility into upcoming or next scheduled runs.

support.subject: As a backend developer, I schedule workflows on cron expressions with overlap policies, pause/resume, and visibility into upcoming runs

citations.quote: A task that is triggered on a recurring schedule using cron syntax.
Create, activate, disable, edit and delete schedules in the dashboard without having to deploy any new code.
The scheduled task feature has been a lifesaver—super simple and just works exactly as expected.
